question: After exact current native grammar is exhausted, does the smallest new durable Afterimage commitment primitive expose enough acquisition-selective, inactive, viable and Scoreline-separated upper capacity to justify its two-knob identity preflight before implementation or any simulator row?
competingOptions: freeze exactly one Mirror Oath carrier and implement only its pool/gate null identity preflight
close the Power-gated Afterimage commitment family and continue with the next materially different structural mechanism inside issue #421
record an inconclusive result at the frozen cap

scientificBasis.measuredBottleneck: Exact #421 evidence found Afterimage locally complementary and naturally reachable, but only 3/128 mechanism witnesses at the scalar candidate. Universal producer-first ordering restored local complementarity, then saturated held-out policy activation. The missing property is durable policy-selective commitment, not another payoff or action-order scalar.
scientificBasis.existingGrammarBoundary: The complete current-main source/evidence audit and terminal Novaflare acquisition screen now close all existing Dusk state, resource, cadence, acquisition and action-order families. Issue #421 therefore authorises the smallest new deterministic primitive.
scientificBasis.minimalityRule: Reuse the already measured Afterimage producer, consumer, status and payoff. Add one binary combat-duration commitment carrier using the catalogue's modal uncommon one-Energy Power shape. Do not add a new damage value, producer, consumer, optimiser or policy threshold.
scientificBasis.whyNotUniversalPowerGrammar: The closed Power-to-next-Attack grammar treated any of eight existing Powers as a transient one-bit producer and saturated at 63/64. Mirror Oath is one exact acquired and played durable gate for one existing package; it is not a subset or retune of that one-bit grammar.
scientificBasis.claimBoundary: This screen is a permissive policy/acquisition/substrate capacity test. It cannot establish an offer, acquisition, play, gate, Afterimage application/consumption, complementarity, whole-run admission or product quality.

statusDefinition.name: Mirror Oath
statusDefinition.desc: Your Ward cards can form Afterimage.

sourceShape.upgradePrecedent: Night Sight is a binary uncommon one-Energy Power whose upgrade changes cost to zero.

candidate.mediator: While the Duskblade has the combat-duration Mirror Oath status, playing the existing starter Ward may create the existing Afterimage status for the existing Warden's Edge consumer.
candidate.authoredPayoff: No new payoff. Existing Warden's Edge Afterimage damage, Ward and consumption remain byte-identical to the frozen candidate substrate.
candidate.structuralDifference: Acquisition and play of one durable Power commit the policy to the Afterimage package before the existing producer-consumer loop can function. This replaces universal producer-first intervention with a natural build and combat commitment.
candidate.shippingBoundary: The card, status and gate are research-only until independent complementarity, activation, separation, reachability, guardrail and promotion gates select them as the minimum.

carrierSelectorFormula.derivation: The carrier has uncommon rarity, printed cost one, one unknown status worth zero under exact current card_score, Power type bonus policy.card.power, no direct effect magnitude and no Dusk aspectBonus entry.
carrierSelectorFormula.scope: This exactly classifies normal-reward acceptance only when Mirror Oath is highest-scoring. Competing offers, shops, events and downstream play are unobserved aliases that can only overstate capacity.

closedDirections: changing Afterimage damage, Ward, status count, producer or Warden's Edge
another Ward setup priority, package-order or positive-median policy threshold
using any existing Power as the carrier or subsetting the closed one-bit Power grammar
changing carrier rarity, cost, upgrade, score, effect magnitude or pool after the first look
adding generic Poise, Ward or another Ashwarden payoff to rescue the carrier
reopening Novaflare, Ember, Kindle, Shatter, cadence, turn-state or other closed native families
ML, RL, an optimiser, protected seeds or adaptive candidate tuning

mirrorOathPool.absent: Exact current profile and card pools; Mirror Oath does not exist in current-main content.
mirrorOathPool.status: Fixed in this zero-row screen. Null/enabled levels are authorised only for identity preflight after a pass.

mirrorOathGate.ungated-current: Exact frozen Afterimage candidate substrate without a Mirror Oath requirement.
mirrorOathGate.status: Fixed observational substrate; not varied here. Null/gated levels are authorised only for identity preflight after a pass.

scorelinePayoff.current: Exact frozen Scoreline payoff and Faultline path.
scorelinePayoff.status: Separate causal factor fixed throughout; never bundled with Afterimage.

afterimagePayoff.current: Exact frozen Warden's Edge Afterimage payoff.
afterimagePayoff.status: Separate causal factor fixed independently from Scoreline; Mirror Oath changes eligibility, not payoff.

acquisitionPriority.current: Exact frozen current card score, decline threshold and natural reward/economy path.

wardSetupPriority.current: Exact current/null Ward setup path; no structural ordering intervention.

designMatrix.kind: single-cell immutable upper-capacity reuse; not a factorial
designMatrix.aliasStructure: The carrier selector assumes it is the best normal reward. The 54-policy substrate is deliberately broad Warden's Edge damage opportunity and does not prove Ward-before-consumer or Afterimage mediation. Intersecting them can only overstate the gated route, so failure is decisive and success authorises identity/telemetry only.
designMatrix.expansionRule: No simulator or joint cell is authorised. After identity preflight, cheap source/mediator telemetry may test whether comparable acquisition and commitment occur. A later mechanism-blocked CRN must keep policies, seeds, baseline, estimator, first-look budget and stop rule equal; add Scoreline or payoff joint cells only when shared-anchor interference has measured decision value.

capacityDefinitions.carrierSelectorPolicy: The exact frozen carrier score is at least the policy's cardDecline threshold.
capacityDefinitions.carrierNonselectorPolicy: The exact carrier score is below cardDecline.
capacityDefinitions.robustRewardOpportunityPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows contain a normal card reward.
capacityDefinitions.afterimageSubstratePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows record positive Warden's Edge damage. This is a permissive consumer-opportunity anchor, not exact Afterimage activation.
capacityDefinitions.afterimageZeroPolicy: No frozen row records positive Warden's Edge damage.
capacityDefinitions.candidatePotentialActivePolicy: Carrier selector, robust reward opportunity and Afterimage substrate all hold on the same policy.
capacityDefinitions.exactInactivePolicy: Carrier nonselector or zero Afterimage substrate holds. Competing-offer and producer-order aliases mean this can still understate true inactivity.
capacityDefinitions.substrateNarrowedOutPolicy: The ungated Afterimage substrate is active but the carrier selector is not; this is the measured commitment narrowing.
capacityDefinitions.viablePotentialActivePolicy: A candidate-potential-active policy has at least one winning frozen row with Warden's Edge damage.
capacityDefinitions.scorelineSeparation: Candidate-only, Scoreline-only, overlap and Jaccard use the same frozen policy identities.

mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: Mirror Oath pool x Mirror Oath gate, because acquisition/play is necessary before the gate can enable the producer
Mirror Oath gate x Afterimage payoff, because the gate changes eligibility while the payoff remains separate
Mirror Oath acquisition x Warden's Edge reachability, because the carrier alone has no package endpoint
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.scorelineInterference: Scoreline remains the other Dusk package. Two-sided policy separation is required now; later joint cells are added only if equal-cohort telemetry or causal evidence can change the decision.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.afterimageAnchorRole: The ungated Afterimage substrate is not a competing package. It is a shared support/narrowing anchor, while Afterimage payoff remains a separate fixed causal factor.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.staging: Source and zero-row repertoire capacity may move to identity-safe path/mediator telemetry. Whole-run claims require every endpoint to be comparably evaluated under one frozen CRN contract.

mirrorOathPool.null: Omitted/zero adds no unlock and exactly reproduces content path, card pools, RNG, policy and results.
mirrorOathPool.enabled: Adds exactly card:mirrorOath through the existing unlock-to-matching-tier pool path; no other card, score, pool or RNG call changes.
mirrorOathPool.intendedMediator: Mirror Oath offer and acquisition eligibility only.

mirrorOathGate.null: Omitted/zero exactly reproduces the frozen ungated Afterimage candidate path, RNG, policy and results.
mirrorOathGate.enabled: Only suppresses Dusk starter Ward's Afterimage application while Mirror Oath status is absent; it does not alter Ward, Warden's Edge, Scoreline, payoff, score or RNG.
mirrorOathGate.intendedMediator: Afterimage producer eligibility conditional on the exact combat-duration Mirror Oath status.

identityPreflightIfAuthorised.proofRule: Prove each null separately and both nulls jointly on all 256 frozen rows. Prove focused enabled controls for exact pool append, aspect gate, status presence/absence and mediator-only suppression before any scientific row.
identityPreflightIfAuthorised.telemetry: Observation-only offer, acquisition, draw, Mirror Oath play, Ward play, gate suppression/application, Warden's Edge play and Afterimage consumption fields; off/on telemetry must be RNG/state inert.

baseline.name: current-main root-551 Duskblade Vow-5 natural reward/economy rectangle

traceEvidence.name: identity-proved explicit-current arm from the Momentum preference CRN rectangle
traceEvidence.identityRule: Every current row exactly equals its cached baseline path, RNG, policy and result after trace/label fields are removed before any carrier or outcome count is read.

cohort.identity: Carrier, substrate, viability and Scoreline separation reuse the exact complete first-look rectangle. No policy or seed is added, removed, selected or replaced.

scoreline.definition: At least two of four rows play Chisel before a later Faultline in the same fight.

afterimageSubstrate.definition: At least two of four rows record positive Warden's Edge damage in the identity-proved current trace.

estimands.unit: Frozen policy identity with a two-of-four robustness rule.
estimands.primary: Exact carrier-selector, candidate-potential-active, inactive, ambiguous and substrate-narrowed-out policy sets.
estimands.viability: Exact candidate-potential-active policies with at least one winning Warden's Edge-opportunity row.
estimands.separation: Exact candidate-only, Scoreline-only, overlap and Jaccard statistics against the separate Scoreline package.
estimands.sourceMinimality: Exact modal carrier shape, absent current candidate ID and exact no-new-payoff primitive definition.
estimands.notEstimated: No actual offer, acquisition, Power play, Ward-before-consumer, status application, complementarity, effect size, interaction, duration, RandomBuild, Ashwarden, detector, protected seed or product endpoint is estimated.

estimator.method: Deterministic exact-source carrier derivation, immutable trace identity and exact policy-set arithmetic.
estimator.model: None. No bootstrap, fitted model, optimiser, ML or RL component is used.
estimator.firstLook: One exact carrier definition, one exact selector, one immutable cohort and one complete first look. No card field, threshold, anchor, predicate or cohort changes after counts are visible.
estimator.stopping: Authorise only the two-knob identity preflight if every gate passes; otherwise close the family or record inconclusive at the cap.

gates.provenance: The 16 active/inactive/narrowing and eight viability/two-sided-separation minima reuse the frozen 64-policy scale. The 0.75 ceiling and one immutable fault are unchanged. Narrowing is required so a new Power cannot merely preserve the broad ungated substrate.

decisionRules.success: Every source-minimality, carrier support/inactivity, reward opportunity, substrate support, candidate support, exact inactivity, measured narrowing, viability, two-sided Scoreline separation and reliability gate passes.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze exactly Mirror Oath and implement only the two preregistered research knobs plus observation-only telemetry on top of the frozen Afterimage candidate substrate. Prove null identity and focused mediator isolation before any simulator row. Do not change a card field, payoff, producer, consumer, cohort or gate.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the Power-gated Afterimage commitment family and continue inside issue #421 with the next materially different structural mechanism. Do not change rarity/cost, add a generic payoff, use another Power carrier or return to package-order/acquisition tuning.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Current-main source, immutable trace or deterministic capacity decision cannot complete before the wall-time cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the inconclusive result at the cap without content implementation, simulator spend, another carrier, ML/RL or protected seeds.

methodBoundary: Deterministic Python owns carrier construction, score evaluation, cache validation, classification and stop/go. #524/#525 enter only through published #421 decisions and are not reconstructed. No model context, human label, optimiser or adaptive candidate iteration enters execution.
